QuestInfo.name: Keep this a Secret from Your Mother
QuestInfo.0: Dr. De Lang made Humanoid A. Dr. De Lang must be skilled in Alchemy. Go ask him about Alchemy.
QuestInfo.1: Dr. De Lang requests that you go destroy the #rSecurity Camera#k and deliver #r#t4033850##k to Keeny, his daughter, so that she can come and go from Alcadno Laboratory freely.
QuestInfo.2: You've delivered the #r#t4033850##k to Keeny, Dr. De Lang's daughter, so that she can come and go freely from the Alcadno Laboratory.

0.0: You met Humanoid A? Yeah, that was my work. Because of that, I am respected in the academic community...but not so much at home. I admit, I am a poor husband and a poor father. I was always too busy with my research to go home.
0.1: I am just glad my daughter Keeny wants to become an alchemist like me. I intend to teach her everything I know. In fact, I have a gift for her. From father to daughter. Will you help me?

yes.0: Alchemy is not something you learn from books. It is learned through trial and error. Keeny is still too young to experiment by herself, but it would help her greatly to observe my experiments.
yes.1: To come and go freely from the laboratory, the #rSecurity Cameras#k must be disabled and Keeny must have the #r#t4033850##k. Sadly, as part of the Alcadno I cannot accomplish these things on my own. Can you take care of it?

no.0: If you are really so busy, I'll not delay you further.

1.0: Wow... Father sent me a gift? That's strange, it's not my birthday...

yes.0: Is this really from Father? He's the best! Now I can go see him every day.

default.0: I want to be an awesome alchemist like my father!

npc.0: Go destroy the #rSecurity Cameras#k and deliver the #r#t4033850##k to my daughter Keeny.
